summary: This bill directs the National Institutes of Health to study hormone level variability in women before perimenopause and the Secretary of Health and Human Services to review the clinical usefulness of hormone testing for perimenopause, with both entities reporting their findings and recommendations to Congress.

scores.thoughts: This bill directs the NIH and HHS to conduct studies and reviews related to hormone variability and testing in women concerning perimenopause. This directly relates to healthcare research and understanding, aiming to improve diagnosis and management of a health condition.
The bill mandates studies by the NIH and HHS, which would involve government resources and therefore some level of government spending to conduct these evaluations and produce reports.
